national.CODE: chart-long — selects code 40010, the national index
national.FREQ: chart-long — quarterly rows to 1993, monthly rows from 1994
national.TIME_PERIOD: chart-long, chart-yoy, chart-dd, chart-recent, kpi:level, insight:peak
national.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-long, chart-dd, chart-dist, chart-new, kpi:level, kpi:peak, insight:long, insight:peak, insight:momentum
national.CHAIN_BASE: chart-long, kpi:level — named as the base of every level figure; quarters on another chain base are dropped
national.NAME_HE: skip: constant CBS label for the one code (מחירי דירות)
national.DATE: skip: the first day of TIME_PERIOD, derived from it
national.VALUE: skip: level on the base in force at the time; VALUE_CHAINED replaces it across bases
national.BASE_DESC: skip: base of VALUE, which the page doesn't chart
districts.CODE: chart-dist, chart-rank, chart-heat — one series per district code, display names by code
districts.NAME_HE: chart-dist — fallback name for a district code without a short label
districts.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-dist, chart-rank, chart-heat, kpi:dist_down, insight:districts_since, insight:districts_yoy — rebased to the first common month
districts.DATE: skip: the first day of TIME_PERIOD, derived from it
districts.VALUE: skip: same as VALUE_CHAINED (one base since Oct 2017); VALUE_CHAINED is read
districts.BASE_DESC: skip: the linking month label (2017 אוקטובר); the page rebases instead of quoting it
districts.PERCENT: skip: monthly change per district; the page compares districts over 12 months and since 2017 from the levels
districts.PERCENT_YEAR: skip: empty for every district row (CBS publishes no y/y change for them)
new.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-new, insight:new_vs_all — rebased to the first month shared with the national index
new.NAME_HE: skip: constant CBS label for the one code
new.DATE: skip: the first day of TIME_PERIOD, derived from it
new.VALUE: skip: same as VALUE_CHAINED (one base); VALUE_CHAINED is read
new.BASE_DESC: skip: the linking month label; the page rebases instead of quoting it
